name: ccxt-mcp
description: Market data, balances and (opt-in) trading across 100+ crypto exchanges and prediction markets via CCXT.
long_description: The official CCXT MCP server. Connect an AI agent to 100+ cryptocurrency exchanges and prediction markets through the unified CCXT API: prices, order books, candles, market search and prediction-market events with no keys; balances, orders and positions once you configure an account; and order placement when you explicitly enable it. Your API keys are stored in the OS keychain and are never visible to the model — it references accounts by name only. Trading is opt-in and sandbox-first: enabling it here allows orders on testnet/sandbox accounts only; live trading must be turned on in the config file.

exchange.title: Exchange 1
exchange.description: First exchange id, e.g. binance, kraken, okx. Fill in as many of the three exchange slots as you want (or none, for public market data only). For a 4th+ exchange or a wallet-based venue, use the config file at the bottom.

apiKey.title: Exchange 1 — API key
apiKey.description: API key for exchange 1. Stored in your OS keychain, never shown to the model. Leave blank for market data only.

secret.title: Exchange 1 — API secret
secret.description: API secret for exchange 1. Stored in your OS keychain.

password.title: Exchange 1 — API passphrase (only OKX / KuCoin / Bitget)
password.description: API passphrase, needed only by some exchanges (OKX, KuCoin, Bitget). Leave blank otherwise. Stored in your OS keychain.

exchange_2.title: Exchange 2 (optional)
exchange_2.description: A second exchange id. Leave blank if unused.

apiKey_2.title: Exchange 2 — API key
apiKey_2.description: API key for exchange 2. Stored in your OS keychain.

secret_2.title: Exchange 2 — API secret
secret_2.description: API secret for exchange 2. Stored in your OS keychain.

password_2.title: Exchange 2 — API passphrase (only OKX / KuCoin / Bitget)
password_2.description: API passphrase for exchange 2, if it needs one. Stored in your OS keychain.

exchange_3.title: Exchange 3 (optional)
exchange_3.description: A third exchange id. Leave blank if unused. For a 4th+ exchange, use the config file below.

apiKey_3.title: Exchange 3 — API key
apiKey_3.description: API key for exchange 3. Stored in your OS keychain.

secret_3.title: Exchange 3 — API secret
secret_3.description: API secret for exchange 3. Stored in your OS keychain.

password_3.title: Exchange 3 — API passphrase (only OKX / KuCoin / Bitget)
password_3.description: API passphrase for exchange 3, if it needs one. Stored in your OS keychain.

sandbox.title: Sandbox / testnet mode (applies to all exchanges above)
sandbox.description: Use each exchange's testnet (fake money). Requires TESTNET API keys from the exchange's testnet portal. Leave OFF if you're using Demo trading below (they're mutually exclusive).

demo.title: Demo trading mode (use INSTEAD of Sandbox for Binance demo keys)
demo.description: Route to the exchange's demo-trading host (e.g. Binance demo.binance.com) instead of the testnet. Use this — not Sandbox — if your keys are from the exchange's Demo Trading portal. Turn Sandbox OFF when you enable this.

enable_trading.title: Allow placing orders — sandbox/demo only (applies to all exchanges above)
enable_trading.description: Enable order placement on sandbox/testnet or demo accounts only. Live trading and withdrawals must be enabled in the config file, not here.

config_file.title: Config file (for 4+ exchanges, wallet venues, or live trading)
config_file.description: Point this at a ccxt-mcp config.json with an "accounts" map to configure any number of exchanges, wallet-based venues (walletAddress/privateKey), or live trading/withdrawals. See https://docs.ccxt.com/#/mcp. It merges with the inline exchanges above; on a name clash the file wins.
